_comment: Thousand Sons army rule (10e). All Is Dust applies a -1 to the wound roll for any single-damage attack allocated to a 'dust' THOUSAND SONS unit (Rubric Marines, Scarab Occult Terminators, etc.). Faction-gated on profile.faction == 'Thousand Sons'; daemon units excluded by the 'DAEMON' unit-keyword check.

simulator.all_is_dust.quoted_text: Each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to a model in this unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
simulator.all_is_dust.trigger: the unit being attacked has profile.faction == 'Thousand Sons' AND does NOT carry the DAEMON unit-keyword, AND the incoming attack's weapon_damage_per_shot <= 1.0
simulator.all_is_dust.effect: Increase the attacker's wound_target by 1 (capped at 7 — wound roll auto-fails). Stacks consistently with attacker-side +1 to wound buffs (e.g. detachment Outbreak of Pestilence) — a single-damage attack with a +1 to wound and a -1 from All Is Dust nets to the base wound target.
